documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Setco Automotive reported Q1 FY26 revenue from operations of Rs. 178.8 crore, representing a 7.8% year-on-year growth compared to Rs. 165.8 crore in Q1 FY25, driven by continued robust demand. EBITDA for Q1 FY26 rose 11.9% year-on-year to Rs. 21.6 crore, supported by higher sales, favourable segment mix, and operational efficiencies.

guidance.claim: The MHCV industry is expected to grow at an exponential double-digit rate of over 30%.
guidance.quote: MHCV industry is expecting to grow at exponential double digit growth rate of >30%

guidance.claim: The company expects 10 to 15% of its overall revenue to come from the tractor business going forward.
guidance.quote: Going forward we are expecting 10-15% of our overall revenue to come from this segment

guidance.claim: Management stated that a revenue per unit increase of about 25% will remain going forward.
guidance.quote: Revenue per unit of ~25% will remain going forward

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth in Q1 FY26 was mainly on account of continued and robust demand for Setco's products.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue from Operations stood at Rs. 178.8 crore in Q1 FY26, as against Rs. 165.8 crore in Q1 FY25, a growth of 7.8% on a year on year basis, mainly on account of continued and robust demand for Setco’s products

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects higher demand for clutches in the aftermarket as fleet utilization improves.
demand_outlook.quote: As economy gets unlocked, fleet utilization will progressively improve and long delayed repairs/over-hauling will be needed, resulting in higher demand for clutches in the aftermarket in coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Setco expects to add 2-3 more OEMs to its farm tractor clutch business in the current financial year.
demand_outlook.quote: Farm Tractor clutches – Business started with two OEM’s viz Sonalika and Preet Tractors, expect to add another 2-3 in this financial year

demand_outlook.claim: Heavy allocation in the budget for infrastructure, mining, and the rural sector is expected to lead to a sharp rebound in MHCV.
demand_outlook.quote: Due to heavy allocation in budget for infrastructure, mining and rural sector is expected to lead to sharp rebound in MHCV

demand_outlook.claim: OEM production schedules of Q4FY21 exceed Q4FY20 and are expected to continue in coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: OEM production schedules of Q4FY21 exceeds Q4FY20. As per available data it is expected to continue in coming years

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket segment saw strong order books, with Q4FY21 demand and order books described as the best ever.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue grew by ~12% in Q3FY21. Strong order book, Q4FY21 demand/order book is the best ever

demand_outlook.claim: Long-overdue replacement of the past has started coming in and is expected to continue for the foreseeable future.
demand_outlook.quote: Long overdue replacement of the past has started coming and expect to continue for the foreseeable future

demand_outlook.claim: The scrappage policy coming into effect from April 2022 will boost demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Long awaited scrappage policy coming into effect from April 2022 will boost the demand

capex_expansion.claim: Planned maintenance capex for Lava Cast is being completed by H1 FY22.
capex_expansion.quote: Lava Cast: Due to liquidity issues, planned maintenance capex is getting completed by H1FY22 and would result in higher capacity utilization

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY26 EBITDA growth was mainly on account of higher sales, favourable segment mix and higher operational efficiencies at LAVA cast and Foreign subsidiaries.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the Q1 FY26 is Rs. 21.6 crore as against Rs. 19.3 crore in Q1 FY25, a year on year growth of 11.9%, mainly on account of higher sales, favourable segment mix and higher operational efficiencies at LAVA cast and Foreign subsidiaries

margins_costs.claim: FY25 EBITDA growth was driven by favourable sales mix, continued operational efficiencies and LAVA Cast turnaround during the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the FY25 is Rs. 109.2 crore as against Rs. 72.5 crore in FY24, a year on year growth of 50.7%, driven by favourable sales mix, continued operational efficiencies and LAVA Cast turnaround during the financial year

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved fixed cost savings of over 24% in the last two years.
margins_costs.quote: Already achieved Fixed cost reduction /savings of over ~24% in last two years

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins in FY21 were impacted by lower operating leverage and a one-quarter lag in passing on raw material price increases.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins has shown a large downfall at 2.9% in FY21 due to lower operating leverages and quarter lag on recovering RM pricing

margins_costs.claim: Contribution margin in Q3FY21 stood at 28.2%, up by 50 bps against 27.7%.
margins_costs.quote: Contribution margin in Q3FY21 at28.2%up by 50bps as against 27.7%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved from 5% in Q3FY20 to 12.5% in Q3FY21, up by 750 bps.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins improved from 5%in Q3FY20 to 12.5% in Q3FY21 up by 750bps (~INR 850 lakhs improvement), due to substantial reduction in fixed cost (down by ~18%)

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved fixed cost reduction and savings of about INR 13 crores till 9MFY21.
margins_costs.quote: Already achieved Fixed cost reduction /savings of ~13 crs till 9MFY21

orders_capacity.claim: Lava Cast has commenced export supplies to the US market with initial volumes rolling out.
orders_capacity.quote: Commenced export supplies to the US market; initial volumes have started rolling out.

orders_capacity.claim: Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd. supplies have begun with two products alongside ongoing efforts to expand the portfolio to 15 products with a prominent aftermarket customer in Germany.
orders_capacity.quote: Supplies have begun with two products; ongoing efforts to expand the portfolio to 15 products with a prominent aftermarket customer in Germany.

orders_capacity.claim: Setco retains over 85% market share in the MHCV OEM segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with >85% market share in MHCV OEM segment.

orders_capacity.claim: The aftermarket segment had an unexecuted order book of approximately 6-8 months of sales.
orders_capacity.quote: Unexecuted strong order book approx. 6-8 months of sales

orders_capacity.claim: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with over 85% market share in the MHCV OEM segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with >85% market share in MHCV OEM segment

capital_allocation.claim: The company is finalizing a fund-raising deal with India Resurgence Fund involving debentures, CCDs, and equity.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment will be in the combination of Debentures (NCDs), CCDs and Equity

capital_allocation.claim: The investment deal includes capital for Lava Cast ramp-up.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital for Lava Cast ramp-up which is integral to the Clutch business success is part of the deal

capital_allocation.claim: The restructuring proposal of the bank for Lava Cast has been approved and implemented.
capital_allocation.quote: Restructuring proposal of bank has been approved and implemented

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces risks from potential future Covid waves and their impact on the economy.
risks_headwinds.quote: Uncertainty on future Covid waves and its impact on economy, competitive strength against existing and potential MNC’s entry into India

risks_headwinds.claim: Lava Cast has faced issues with low capacity utilization and high rejection rates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Teething problems: LowerCapacity utilization (max achieved is only ~52%) and high rejection rates (~17% - 19%).

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain constraints affected production during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Q3FY21 would have been much better, but supply chain constraint has affected the production

risks_headwinds.claim: Frequent lockdowns in foreign countries resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability for overseas subsidiaries.
risks_headwinds.quote: Frequent lockdown in foreign countries has resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to complete the documentation and formalities for the India Resurgence Fund deal in 7-15 days.
management_commitments.quote: Expect to complete all formalities in next 7-15 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reap the benefits of the business cycle turning to growth in H2 FY22.
management_commitments.quote: Despite steep OEM slowdown, we continue to enjoy over 85% market share and are poised to reap the benefit when the business cycle turns to growth in H2 FY22.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start supplies with a few other tractor OEMs in the next 3-4 months.
management_commitments.quote: Farm equipment : Sales started with 2 OEM’s, expects to start with few others in next 3-4 months

management_commitments.claim: Management's efforts toward rationalizing fixed costs will continue in coming years, which will add to the bottom line.
management_commitments.quote: Our effortsrationalizingfixed cost will continuein coming years,whichwill addtothebottomline.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
